text: しょうぶ　してみるわ！

structure.jp: しょうぶ　してみるわ！

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after the て-form of a verb means doing it to see how it goes. しょうぶ してみる = 'I'll try battling'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, feminine tone. してみるわ = 'I'll give it a try!'
